title: Implement MCP server with HTTP/WebSocket transport
description:
Python MCP server for remote command execution using uv for environment management. Requirements:
- HTTP/WebSocket transport (SSE)
- Full command execution access
- Using uv for Python environment
- MCP Python SDK

comments.text:
INVESTIGATION:
- Fresh project, no existing code
- User wants HTTP/WebSocket transport (SSE) for remote access
- Full command execution access (security warning given)
- Must use uv for Python environment management

Plan:
1. Initialize Python project with uv (pyproject.toml, src/ layout)
2. Install mcp Python SDK
3. Create MCP server with SSE transport
4. Implement execute_command tool
5. Add HTTP server for WebSocket/SSE support
